name: PSDI-PFNO
description: This repository contains the CFD dataset, supporting numerical records and source code accompanying the manuscript “Prior-conditioned patch-based neural operator for rapid indoor airflow field reconstruction under obstacle relocation”. The dataset comprises 78 steady, isothermal indoor airflow conditions with varying obstacle positions and inlet speeds. It includes native-cell CFD CSV exports, canonical-grid HDF5 velocity fields, normalized model-input arrays, geometry caches and condition manifests. The final model uses 58 Development conditions and is evaluated on 20 benchmark conditions. Canonical velocity fields have shape (3, 60, 80, 160), with components (u, v, w) and spatial ordering (z, y, x). Model-input velocities are normalized by the condition-specific inlet speed. The PSDI-PFNO source code provides a five-stage workflow: CFD data preparation, clamped dual-frame prior construction, three-seed model training, complete velocity-field reconstruction and benchmark evaluation. Reconstruction uses CFD-sampled sparse velocity observations. Model checkpoints are generated by the supplied training stage. Supporting files contain per-condition and summary results, model settings, mesh-selection records and CFD-validation comparisons. Published measurement records used for validation retain their original source attribution. Archive README files document the contents, units and execution instructions. SHA256SUMS.csv provides checksums for the four distributed archives.
